relationshipProposals.passage: L0001-COMPONENTS: Red cell mass, hemoglobin concentration, and hematocrit evaluate microcytic, normocytic, and macrocytic anemias.
relationshipProposals.rationale: Complete Blood Count is the primary diagnostic laboratory test for Anemia (D0051).

relationshipProposals.passage: L0001-INDICATION: Indicated for screening unexplained fatigue, weakness, or pallor.
relationshipProposals.rationale: CBC screens for occult anemia or chronic inflammatory states underlying systemic fatigue.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0001-INDICATION: WBC count and automated differential analyze leukocyte shifts during febrile illnesses.
relationshipProposals.rationale: CBC WBC count evaluates leukocytosis/neutrophilia in patients presenting with fever.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0001-COMPONENTS: Platelet count quantifies thrombocyte mass to assess petechiae, purpura, or easy bruising.
relationshipProposals.rationale: Platelet evaluation screens for thrombocytopenia in patients presenting with unexplained mucosal bleeding or purpura.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0001-INTERPRETATION: Low MCV on CBC indicates microcytic anemia requiring serum ferritin correlation.
relationshipProposals.rationale: CBC microcytosis directly indicates serum Ferritin (L0015) testing to differentiate iron deficiency from thalassemia.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0002-INDICATION: Serum TSH is the primary diagnostic screening biomarker for Hypothyroidism (D0011).
relationshipProposals.rationale: TSH is the gold-standard first-line laboratory test for screening primary hypothyroidism.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0002-INDICATION: Suppressed TSH (< 0.45 mIU/L) screens for Hyperthyroidism (D0012) and thyrotoxicosis.
relationshipProposals.rationale: Suppressed serum TSH indicates primary hyperthyroidism, Graves' disease, or toxic nodular goiter.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0002-INTERPRETATION: Abnormal TSH triggers reflex Free T4 (L0036) measurement to distinguish overt from subclinical thyroid disease.
relationshipProposals.rationale: TSH and Free T4 operate in a reciprocal log-linear feedback loop and are interpreted together.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0002-INTERPRETATION: Elevated TSH prompts Anti-TPO autoantibody (L0039) testing to evaluate autoimmune thyroiditis (Hashimoto's).
relationshipProposals.rationale: TSH elevation is correlated with Anti-TPO antibody titers to establish etiology.

relationshipProposals.passage: L0002-INDICATION: Indicated for evaluating unexplained systemic fatigue, lethargy, or hypometabolic symptoms.
relationshipProposals.rationale: TSH screening evaluates endocrine thyroid hypofunction in patients presenting with chronic fatigue.
